image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a Rhodesian Ridgeback dog standing on a dirt path in a hilly, arid landscape. The dog is looking up towards the camera with its mouth open. The background features rolling hills and a blue sky with clouds. The lighting is bright and natural.
